source: Vaultwarden 1.37.5 has no API document: these are the calls its own admin page makes (vw_static/admin.js, admin_users.js, admin_settings.js, admin_diagnostics.js, admin_organizations.js), the pages it serves them from, and its health and version calls, from the throwaway vaultwarden/server checked on 2026-11-08. The actions answer only JSON requests.
